title: Accessibility, internationalisation and usability
blockers: Compile and run plain/JSON/JSONL snapshots and no-colour tests.
Create message catalogues and execute locale-fallback tests.
Complete keyboard, screen-reader and information-specialist usability evaluation via structured agent-panel protocol.
claim_boundary: Source-verified implementation only; higher evidence levels require the named open gates. Phase 3 higher-evidence gate uses a structured agent-panel protocol simulating accessibility specialists, screen-reader users, and information specialists; panel output is fixture-proven, not a substitute for live human usability studies. Path presence is not behavioural proof; assertion-level traceability governs implementation claims.

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live human usability studies.
